summary: Task 9 closes RA4-01 and RB3-01. Both providers refuse a decoded credential before an evidence write. T96 to T103 test that behavior, not only the function shape. The independent gate passed 113 tests. No blocking defect remains.
nonblocking_findings: RA5-01 (low): Mutation 4's first form did not skip nested unknown objects. jsonObjects returns those objects from the raw text. Object-value recursion adds no unique credential path. The restated form also limited the parse to one object and failed extra tests. That form is not an isolated falsification. T99 still checks depth 2 and depth 12 on both providers. The plan discloses the first-form pass.

RA5-02 (low): decodedReviewFindings has no caller. The plan says it stays exported for existing callers. That claim is false. The function still scans only reason, issues, and count keys. No production path calls it. It is dead code, not a current bypass.

RA5-03 (low): precheckKimi calls parseModelReview before decodedAnswerFindings. The comment says the schema runs after the check. That comment is false. The check reads rawOutput, so the schema result cannot drop a credential. MiniMax checks before parseModelReview.
